details: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has proposed exploring the use of cryptocurrency to circumvent potential international banking sanctions. This idea has been met with significant criticism from the Bank of Israel and over 100 economists, who warn that such a move could severely harm Israel's economic standing and lead to diplomatic and financial isolation.
title: Israel PM Suggests Crypto for Sanctions Evasion

details: The US dollar is struggling to maintain strength, with lower Treasury yields driven by "AI anxiety" offsetting the impact of rising energy prices fueled by geopolitical conflicts. Defensive capital flows into government bonds amidst a sell-off in AI and semiconductor stocks have further pressured the dollar's rate advantage.
title: Geopolitical Tensions, AI Anxiety Pressure US Dollar
